master-ball.descES: La Poké Ball definitiva. Atrapa cualquier Pokémon salvaje y no falla nunca.
master-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Catches a wild Pokémon without fail. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

ultra-ball.descES: Poké Ball de rendimiento superior. Tiene un índice de éxito mayor al de la Super Ball.
ultra-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 2x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

great-ball.descES: Poké Ball de alto rendimiento. Tiene un índice de éxito superior al de la Poké Ball.
great-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1.5x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

poke-ball.descES: Dispositivo con diseño capsular que atrapa Pokémon salvajes. Se lanza como una bola contra el blanco.
poke-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

safari-ball.descES: Poké Ball especial que se utilizaba en lugares como la Zona Safari de Kanto y el Gran Pantano de Sinnoh.
safari-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1.5x. This item can only be used in the Great Marsh or Safari Zone.

net-ball.descES: Es algo distinta a las demás. Funciona especialmente bien con los Pokémon de tipo Agua y Bicho.
net-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon is Water- or Bug-type, this ball has a catch rate of 3x. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

dive-ball.descES: Es algo distinta a las demás. Funciona especialmente bien con los Pokémon que viven bajo el agua.
dive-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon was encountered by surfing or fishing, this ball has a catch rate of 3.5x. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

nest-ball.descES: Es algo distinta a las demás. Funciona especialmente bien con los Pokémon salvajes de nivel bajo.
nest-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. Has a catch rate of given by `(40 - level) / 10`, where `level` is the wild Pokémon’s level, to a maximum of 3.9x for level 1 Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon’s level is higher than 30, this ball has a catch rate of 1x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

repeat-ball.descES: Es algo distinta a las demás. Funciona especialmente bien con las especies de Pokémon ya capturadas.
repeat-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon’s species is marked as caught in the trainer’s Pokédex, this ball has a catch rate of 3x. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

timer-ball.descES: Una Poké Ball algo distinta que va mejorando su rendimiento con cada turno de combate.
timer-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. Has a catch rate of 1.1x on the first turn of the battle and increases by 0.1x every turn, to a maximum of 4x on turn 30. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

luxury-ball.descES: Acogedora Poké Ball que hace más amistosos a los Pokémon salvajes capturados.
luxury-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1x. Whenever the caught Pokémon’s happiness increases, it increases by one extra point. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

premier-ball.descES: Es una Poké Ball algo singular que se creó para conmemorar algún acontecimiento.
premier-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

dusk-ball.descES: Es algo particular. Hace que sea más fácil capturar a los Pokémon salvajes por la noche o en lugares oscuros.
dusk-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If it’s currently nighttime or the wild Pokémon was encountered while walking in a cave, this ball has a catch rate of 3.5x. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

heal-ball.descES: Poké Ball curativa que restaura los PS y cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon después de capturarlo.
heal-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1x. The caught Pokémon’s HP is immediately restored, PP for all its moves is restored, and any status ailment is cured. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

quick-ball.descES: Una Poké Ball algo distinta que potencia el índice de captura si se usa al inicio de un encuentro con Pokémon salvajes.
quick-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 4x on the first turn of a battle, but 1x any other time. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

cherish-ball.descES: Es una Poké Ball bastante singular que se creó para conmemorar alguna ocasión especial.
cherish-ball.descEN: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1x. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.

potion.descES: Medicina en espray que cura heridas y restaura 20 PS a un Pokémon.
potion.descEN: Used on a friendly Pokémon : Restores 20 HP.

antidote.descES: Medicina en espray que contrarresta los efectos del veneno en un Pokémon.
antidote.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures poison.

burn-heal.descES: Medicina en espray que cura las quemaduras a un Pokémon.
burn-heal.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures a burn.

ice-heal.descES: Medicina en espray que descongela a un Pokémon.
ice-heal.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures freezing.

awakening.descES: Medicina en espray que libera a un Pokémon de las garras del sueño.
awakening.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures sleep.

paralyze-heal.descES: Medicina en espray que cura a un Pokémon paralizado.
paralyze-heal.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures paralysis.

full-restore.descES: Medicina que restaura todos los PS y cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
full-restore.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores HP to full and cures any status ailment and confusion.

max-potion.descES: Medicina en espray que cura heridas y restaura todos los PS de un Pokémon.
max-potion.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores HP to full.

hyper-potion.descES: Medicina en espray que cura heridas y restaura 120 PS de un Pokémon.
hyper-potion.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 200 HP.

super-potion.descES: Medicina en espray que cura heridas y restaura 60 PS de un Pokémon.
super-potion.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 50 HP.

full-heal.descES: Medicina en espray que cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
full-heal.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures any status ailment and confusion.

revive.descES: Medicina que revive a un Pokémon debilitado y le devuelve la mitad de sus PS.
revive.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Revives the Pokémon and restores half its HP.

max-revive.descES: Medicina que revive a un Pokémon debilitado y le devuelve todos sus PS.
max-revive.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Revives the Pokémon and restores its HP to full.

fresh-water.descES: Agua de alto contenido mineral que restaura 30 PS de un Pokémon.
fresh-water.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 50 HP.

soda-pop.descES: Chispeante bebida gaseosa que restaura 50 PS de un Pokémon.
soda-pop.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 60 HP.

lemonade.descES: Bebida muy dulce que restaura 70 PS de un Pokémon.
lemonade.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 80 HP.

moomoo-milk.descES: Leche de alto valor nutritivo que restaura 100 PS de un Pokémon.
moomoo-milk.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 100 HP.

energy-powder.descES: Polvo medicinal muy amargo que restaura 60 PS de un Pokémon.
energy-powder.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 50 HP. Decreases happiness by 5/5/10.

energy-root.descES: Raíz muy amarga que restaura 120 PS de un Pokémon.
energy-root.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 200 HP. Decreases happiness by 10/10/15.

heal-powder.descES: Polvos medicinales muy amargos que curan todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
heal-powder.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures any status ailment. Decreases happiness by 5/5/10.

revival-herb.descES: Hierba muy amarga que reanima a un Pokémon debilitado y restaura todos sus PS.
revival-herb.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Revives a fainted Pokémon and restores its HP to full. Decreases happiness by 10/10/15.

ether.descES: Restaura 10 PP del movimiento elegido de un Pokémon.
ether.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 10 PP for a selected move.

max-ether.descES: Restaura completamente los PP del movimiento elegido de un Pokémon.
max-ether.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores PP to full for a selected move.

elixir.descES: Restaura 10 PP de todos los movimientos aprendidos por el Pokémon elegido.
elixir.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 10 PP for each move.

max-elixir.descES: Restaura completamente los PP de todos los movimientos aprendidos por el Pokémon elegido.
max-elixir.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores PP to full for each move.

lava-cookie.descES: Dulce típico de Pueblo Lavacalda que cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
lava-cookie.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures any status ailment and confusion.

berry-juice.descES: Zumo de bayas 100% natural que restaura 20 PS de un Pokémon.
berry-juice.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 20 HP.

sacred-ash.descES: Reanima completamente a todos los Pokémon debilitados y restaura todos sus PS.
sacred-ash.descEN: Used : Revives all fainted Pokémon in the party and restores their HP to full.

hp-up.descES: Nutritiva bebida que potencia los PS de base de un Pokémon.
hp-up.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases HP effort by 10, but won’t increase it beyond 100. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

protein.descES: Nutritiva bebida que potencia el Ataque de base de un Pokémon.
protein.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases Attack effort by 10, but won’t increase it beyond 100. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

iron.descES: Nutritiva bebida que potencia la Defensa de base de un Pokémon.
iron.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases Defense effort by 10, but won’t increase it beyond 100. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

carbos.descES: Nutritiva bebida que potencia la Velocidad de base de un Pokémon.
carbos.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases Speed effort by 10, but won’t increase it beyond 100. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

calcium.descES: Nutritiva bebida que potencia el Ataque Especial de base de un Pokémon.
calcium.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases Special Attack effort by 10, but won’t increase it beyond 100. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

rare-candy.descES: Caramelo energético que sube a un Pokémon de nivel.
rare-candy.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases level by 1. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

pp-up.descES: Aumenta ligeramente los PP máximos del movimiento elegido de un Pokémon.
pp-up.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases a selected move’s max PP by 20% its original max PP, to a maximum of 1.6x. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

zinc.descES: Nutritiva bebida que aumenta la Defensa Especial de base de un Pokémon.
zinc.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases Special Defense effort by 10, but won’t increase it beyond 100. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

pp-max.descES: Aumenta hasta el límite los PP máximos del movimiento elegido de un Pokémon.
pp-max.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Increases a selected move’s max PP to 1.6x its original max PP. Increases happiness by 5/3/2.

old-gateau.descES: Especialidad de la Vieja Mansión. Cura todos los problemas de estado de un Pokémon.
old-gateau.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures any status ailment and confusion.

guard-spec.descES: Evita que bajen las características del equipo Pokémon durante cinco turnos.
guard-spec.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Protects the target’s stats from being lowered for the next five turns. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.

dire-hit.descES: Aumenta el índice de golpe crítico en combate. Solo se puede usar una vez y, al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
dire-hit.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Increases the target’s critical hit chance by one stage until it leaves the field. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.

x-attack.descES: Aumenta mucho el Ataque en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-attack.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Attack by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.

x-defense.descES: Aumenta mucho la Defensa en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-defense.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Defense by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.

x-speed.descES: Aumenta mucho la Velocidad en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-speed.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Speed by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.

x-accuracy.descES: Aumenta mucho la Precisión en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-accuracy.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s accuracy by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.

x-sp-atk.descES: Aumenta mucho el Ataque Especial en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-sp-atk.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.

x-sp-def.descES: Aumenta mucho la Defensa Especial en combate. Al cambiar de Pokémon, el efecto desaparece.
x-sp-def.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Raises the target’s Special Defense by one stage. Increases happiness by 1/1/0.

poke-doll.descES: Un muñeco que atrae a los Pokémon. Es útil para huir de un combate contra un Pokémon salvaje.
poke-doll.descEN: Used in battle : Ends a wild battle. Cannot be used in trainer battles.

fluffy-tail.descES: Un objeto que atrae a los Pokémon. Es útil para huir de un combate contra un Pokémon salvaje.
fluffy-tail.descEN: Used in battle : Ends a wild battle. Cannot be used in trainer battles.

blue-flute.descES: Una flauta de cristal azul cuyas notas despiertan a un Pokémon del sueño.
blue-flute.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Cures sleep.

yellow-flute.descES: Una flauta de cristal amarillo cuyas notas sacan a un Pokémon de la confusión.
yellow-flute.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Cures confusion.

red-flute.descES: Una flauta de cristal rojo cuyas notas vuelven en sí a un Pokémon enamorado.
red-flute.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon in battle : Cures attraction.

black-flute.descES: Una flauta de cristal negro cuyas notas atraen a Pokémon salvajes más fuertes al lugar en el que se usa.
black-flute.descEN: Used outside of battle : Decreases the wild Pokémon encounter rate by 50%.

white-flute.descES: Una flauta de cristal blanco cuyas notas atraen a Pokémon salvajes más débiles al lugar en el que se usa.
white-flute.descEN: Used outside of battle : Doubles the wild Pokémon encounter rate.

shoal-salt.descES: Una sal muy fina que se encuentra en la Cueva Cardumen.

shoal-shell.descES: Concha que se encuentra en la Cueva Cardumen.

red-shard.descES: Un pequeño fragmento rojo. Parece formar parte de algún tipo de herramienta antigua.
red-shard.descEN: No effect. In Diamond and Pearl, trade ten for a Sunny Day TM in the house midway along the southern section of Route 212. In Platinum, trade to move tutors on Route 212, in Snowpoint City, and in the Survival Area. Eight shards total are required per tutelage, but the particular combination of colors varies by move. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Cheri Berry, a Leppa Berry, and a Pecha Berry with the Juggler near the Pokémon Center in Violet City. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Persim Berry, a Pomeg Berry, and a Razz Berry with the Juggler near the Pal Park entrance in Fuchsia City.

blue-shard.descES: Un pequeño fragmento azul. Parece formar parte de algún tipo de herramienta antigua.
blue-shard.descEN: No effect. In Diamond and Pearl, trade ten for a Rain Dance TM in the house midway along the southern section of Route 212. In Platinum, trade to move tutors on Route 212, in Snowpoint City, and in the Survival Area. Eight shards total are required per tutelage, but the particular combination of colors varies by move. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Chesto Berry, an Oran Berry, and a Wiki Berry with the Juggler near the Pokémon Center in Violet City. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Bluk Berry, a Cornn Berry, and a Kelpsy Berry with the Juggler near the Pal Park entrance in Fuchsia City.

yellow-shard.descES: Un pequeño fragmento amarillo. Parece formar parte de algún tipo de herramienta antigua.
yellow-shard.descEN: No effect. In Diamond and Pearl, trade ten for a Sandstorm TM in the house midway along the southern section of Route 212. In Platinum, trade to move tutors on Route 212, in Snowpoint City, and in the Survival Area. Eight shards total are required per tutelage, but the particular combination of colors varies by move. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for an Aspear Berry, a Iapapa Berry, and a Sitrus Berry with the Juggler near the Pokémon Center in Violet City. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Grepa Berry, a Nomel Berry, and a Pinap Berry with the Juggler near the Pal Park entrance in Fuchsia City.

green-shard.descES: Un pequeño fragmento verde. Parece formar parte de algún tipo de herramienta antigua.
green-shard.descEN: No effect. In Diamond and Pearl, trade ten for a Hail TM in the house midway along the southern section of Route 212. In Platinum, trade to move tutors on Route 212, in Snowpoint City, and in the Survival Area. Eight shards total are required per tutelage, but the particular combination of colors varies by move. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for an Aguav Berry, a Lum Berry, and a Rawst Berry with the Juggler near the Pokémon Center in Violet City. In HeartGold and SoulSilver, trade one for a Durin Berry, a Hondew Berry, and a Wepear Berry with the Juggler near the Pal Park entrance in Fuchsia City.

super-repel.descES: Evita encuentros con Pokémon salvajes débiles durante más tiempo que un Repelente normal.
super-repel.descEN: Used outside of battle : Trainer will skip encounters with wild Pokémon of a lower level than the lead party Pokémon. This effect wears off after the trainer takes 200 steps.

max-repel.descES: Evita encuentros con Pokémon salvajes débiles durante más tiempo que un Superrepelente.
max-repel.descEN: Used outside of battle : Trainer will skip encounters with wild Pokémon of a lower level than the lead party Pokémon. This effect wears off after the trainer takes 250 steps.

escape-rope.descES: Cuerda larga y resistente que sirve para huir de cuevas y sitios cerrados en general. Puede usarse tantas veces como se quiera.
escape-rope.descEN: Used outside of battle : Transports the trainer to the last-entered dungeon entrance. Cannot be used outside, in buildings, or in Distortion World, Hall Of Origin, Spear Pillar, or Turnback Cave.

repel.descES: Evita encuentros con Pokémon salvajes débiles durante un corto período de tiempo.
repel.descEN: Used outside of battle : Trainer will skip encounters with wild Pokémon of a lower level than the lead party Pokémon. This effect wears off after the trainer takes 100 steps.

sun-stone.descES: Curiosa piedra que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon. Es roja como el núcleo del sol.
sun-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves a Cottonee into Whimsicott, a Gloom into Bellossom, a Petilil into Lilligant, or a Sunkern into Sunflora.

moon-stone.descES: Curiosa piedra que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon. Es oscura como la noche.
moon-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves a Clefairy into Clefable, a Jigglypuff into Wigglytuff, a Munna into Musharna, a Nidorina into Nidoqueen, a Nidorino into Nidoking, or a Skitty into Delcatty.

fire-stone.descES: Curiosa piedra que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon. Es amarilla con una marca naranja.
fire-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves an Eevee into Flareon, a Growlithe into Arcanine, a Pansear into Simisear, or a Vulpix into Ninetales.

thunder-stone.descES: Curiosa piedra que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon. Tiene grabado un rayo.
thunder-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves an Eelektrik into Eelektross, an Eevee into Jolteon, or a Pikachu into Raichu.

water-stone.descES: Curiosa piedra que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon. Es de color azul.
water-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves an Eevee into Vaporeon, a Lombre into Ludicolo, a Panpour into Simipour, a Poliwhirl into Poliwrath, a Shellder into Cloyster, or a Staryu into Starmie.

leaf-stone.descES: Curiosa piedra que hace evolucionar a determinadas especies de Pokémon. Tiene grabada una hoja.
leaf-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves an Exeggcute into Exeggutor, a Gloom into Vileplume, a Nuzleaf into Shiftry, a Pansage into Simisage, or a Weepinbell into Victreebel.

tiny-mushroom.descES: Una pequeña seta que es poco común y bastante popular entre determinados grupos de gourmets.

big-mushroom.descES: Una gran seta que es poco común y muy popular entre determinados grupos de gourmets.

pearl.descES: Brillante perla pequeña y plateada que no alcanza un buen precio en las tiendas.

big-pearl.descES: Brillante perla plateada de gran tamaño que puede venderse a buen precio en las tiendas.

stardust.descES: Bonita arena roja de tacto sedoso que no alcanza un buen precio en las tiendas.

star-piece.descES: Fragmento de una bonita gema roja que puede venderse muy caro en las tiendas.

nugget.descES: Pepita de oro puro que desprende un brillo espectacular. Puede venderse a un precio muy alto en las tiendas.

heart-scale.descES: Una bella y rara escama con forma de corazón que más de uno apreciará si se la entregas.
heart-scale.descEN: Trade one to the Move Relearner near the shore in Pastoria City or with the Move Deleter in Blackthorn City to teach one party Pokémon a prior level-up move.

honey.descES: Miel de dulce aroma recolectada por los Pokémon, que no alcanza un buen precio en las tiendas.
honey.descEN: Used outside of battle : Immediately triggers a wild Pokémon battle, as long as the trainer is somewhere with wild Pokémon—i.e., in tall grass, in a cave, or surfing. Can be smeared on sweet-smelling trees to attract tree-dwelling Pokémon after six hours.

growth-mulch.descES: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
growth-mulch.descEN: Used on a patch of soil : Plant’s growth stages will each last 25% less time. Dries soil out more quickly.

damp-mulch.descES: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
damp-mulch.descEN: Used on a patch of soil : Plant’s growth stages will each last 25% more time. Dries soil out more slowly.

stable-mulch.descES: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
stable-mulch.descEN: Used on a patch of soil : Fully-grown plant will last 25% longer before dying and possibly regrowing.

gooey-mulch.descES: Un fertilizante usado para el cultivo de bayas. Parece que no se asienta bien en el suelo de Hoenn, por lo que no tiene efecto en esta región.
gooey-mulch.descEN: Used on a path of soil : Plant will regrow after dying 25% more times.

root-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que vivía en el fondo del mar. Parece ser parte de una raíz.
root-fossil.descEN: Give to a scientist in the Mining Museum in Oreburgh City or the Museum of Science in Pewter City to receive a Lileep.

claw-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que vivía en el fondo del mar. Parece ser parte de una garra.
claw-fossil.descEN: Give to a scientist in the Mining Museum in Oreburgh City or the Museum of Science in Pewter City to receive an Anorith.

helix-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que vivía en el fondo del mar. Parece ser un fragmento de concha marina.
helix-fossil.descEN: Give to a scientist in the Mining Museum in Oreburgh City or the Museum of Science in Pewter City to receive an Omanyte.

dome-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico que vivía en el fondo del mar. Parece ser un fragmento de caparazón.
dome-fossil.descEN: Give to a scientist in the Mining Museum in Oreburgh City or the Museum of Science in Pewter City to receive a Kabuto.

old-amber.descES: Fragmento de ámbar que contiene información genética de un Pokémon prehistórico. Es de color amarillo.
old-amber.descEN: Give to a scientist in the Mining Museum in Oreburgh City or the Museum of Science in Pewter City to receive an Aerodactyl.

armor-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico terrestre. Parece ser parte de una protección ósea del cuello.
armor-fossil.descEN: Give to a scientist in the Mining Museum in Oreburgh City or the Museum of Science in Pewter City to receive a Shieldon.

skull-fossil.descES: Fósil de un Pokémon prehistórico terrestre. Parece ser parte de una cabeza.
skull-fossil.descEN: Give to a scientist in the Mining Museum in Oreburgh City or the Museum of Science in Pewter City to receive a Cranidos.

rare-bone.descES: Un hueso de gran valor para la arqueología Pokémon. Puede alcanzar un alto precio en las tiendas.

shiny-stone.descES: Una piedra peculiar que hace evolucionar a algunos Pokémon. Tiene un brillo espectacular.
shiny-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves a Minccino into Cinccino, a Roselia into Roserade, or a Togetic into Togekiss.

dusk-stone.descES: Una piedra peculiar que hace evolucionar a algunos Pokémon. Es oscura como la noche.
dusk-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves a Lampent into Chandelure, a Misdreavus into Mismagius, or a Murkrow into Honchkrow.

dawn-stone.descES: Una piedra peculiar que hace evolucionar a algunos Pokémon. Brilla como un lucero.
dawn-stone.descEN: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves a male Kirlia into Gallade or a female Snorunt into Froslass.

oval-stone.descES: Una piedra peculiar que hace evolucionar a algunos Pokémon. Tiene forma de huevo.
oval-stone.descEN: Held by Happiny : Holder evolves into Chansey when it levels up during the daytime.

odd-keystone.descES: Vital para impedir que una torre de piedra se derrumbe. A veces se oyen voces en su interior.
odd-keystone.descEN: Place in the tower on Route 209. Check the stone to encounter a Spiritomb, as long as the trainer’s Underground status card counts at least 32 greetings.

adamant-orb.descES: Una esfera brillante que potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero y Dragón. Debe llevarla Dialga.
adamant-orb.descEN: Held by Dialga : Holder’s Dragon- and Steel-type moves have 1.2x their usual power.

lustrous-orb.descES: Una bonita esfera que potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón y Agua. Debe llevarla Palkia.
lustrous-orb.descEN: Held by Palkia : Holder’s Dragon- and Water-type moves have 1.2x their usual power.

Once taken and read, a message may be erased and this item can be reused, or the message may be stored in the trainer’s PC. Held : Holder cannot be placed in the PC. Any move attempting to remove this item from the holder will fail.

cheri-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para recuperarse de la parálisis.
cheri-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is paralyzed, it consumes this item to cure the paralysis. Used on a party Pokémon : Cures paralysis.

chesto-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para despertar del sueño.
chesto-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is asleep, it consumes this item to wake up. Used on a party Pokémon : Cures sleep.

pecha-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para curarse del envenenamiento.
pecha-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is poisoned, it consumes this item to cure the poison. Used on a party Pokémon : Cures poison.

rawst-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para curarse las quemaduras.
rawst-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is burned, it consumes this item to cure the burn. Used on a party Pokémon : Cures a burn.

aspear-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para descongelarse.
aspear-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is frozen, it consumes this item to thaw itself. Used on a party Pokémon : Cures freezing.

leppa-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para restaurar 10 PP de un movimiento.
leppa-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is out of PP for one of its moves, it consumes this item to restore 10 of that move’s PP. Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 10 PP for a selected move.

oran-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para restaurar 10 PS.
oran-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/2 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to restore 10 HP. Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 10 HP.

persim-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para librarse de la confusión.
persim-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is confused, it consumes this item to cure the confusion. Used on a party Pokémon : Cures confusion.

lum-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para recuperarse de problemas de estado.
lum-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is afflicted with a major status ailment, it consumes this item to cure the ailment. Used on a party Pokémon : Cures any major status ailment.

sitrus-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para restaurar algunos PS.
sitrus-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/2 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to restore 1/4 its max HP. Used on a party Pokémon : Restores 1/4 the Pokémon’s max HP.

figy-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para restaurar algunos PS. Su sabor puede causar confusión si no les gusta.
figy-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/2 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to restore 1/8 its max HP. If the holder dislikes spicy flavors (i.e., has a nature that lowers Attack), it will also become confused.

wiki-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para restaurar algunos PS. Su sabor puede causar confusión si no les gusta.
wiki-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/2 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to restore 1/8 its max HP. If the holder dislikes dry flavors (i.e., has a nature that lowers Special Attack), it will also become confused.

mago-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para restaurar algunos PS. Su sabor puede causar confusión si no les gusta.
mago-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/2 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to restore 1/8 its max HP. If the holder dislikes sweet flavors (i.e., has a nature that lowers Speed), it will also become confused.

aguav-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para restaurar algunos PS. Su sabor puede causar confusión si no les gusta.
aguav-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/2 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to restore 1/8 its max HP. If the holder dislikes bitter flavors (i.e., has a nature that lowers Special Defense), it will also become confused.

iapapa-berry.descES: Los Pokémon pueden llevarla o usarla para restaurar algunos PS. Su sabor puede causar confusión si no les gusta.
iapapa-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/2 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to restore 1/8 its max HP. If the holder dislikes sour flavors (i.e., has a nature that lowers Defense), it will also become confused.

razz-berry.descEN: No effect; only useful for planting and cooking.

chilan-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder would take Normal-type damage, it consumes this item to halve the amount of damage taken.

liechi-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, le sube el Ataque en un momento de apuro.
liechi-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to raise its Attack by one stage.

ganlon-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, le sube la Defensa en un momento de apuro.
ganlon-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to raise its Defense by one stage.

salac-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, le sube la Velocidad en un momento de apuro.
salac-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to raise its Speed by one stage.

petaya-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, le sube el Ataque Especial en un momento de apuro.
petaya-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to raise its Special Attack by one stage.

apicot-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, le sube la Defensa Especial en un momento de apuro.
apicot-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to raise its Special Defense by one stage.

lansat-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, aumenta la probabilidad de dar un golpe crítico en un momento de apuro.
lansat-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to raise its critical hit chance by one stage.

starf-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon, aumenta mucho una característica en un momento de apuro.
starf-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item to raise a random stat by two stages.

enigma-berry.descES: Restaura los PS de un Pokémon si la lleva cuando le alcanza un ataque supereficaz.
enigma-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder takes super-effective damage, it consumes this item to restore 1/4 its max HP.

micle-berry.descES: Cuando la lleva un Pokémon, le sube la precisión de un movimiento en un momento de apuro.
micle-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item, and its next used move has 1.2x its normal accuracy.

custap-berry.descES: El Pokémon que la lleva puede actuar en primer lugar una vez cuando se encuentra en un momento de apuro.
custap-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder has 1/4 its max HP remaining or less, it consumes this item. On the following turn, the holder will act first among moves with the same priority, regardless of Speed.

jaboca-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon cuando otro lanza un ataque físico, este último también recibe daño.
jaboca-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder takes physical damage, it consumes this item to damage the attacking Pokémon for 1/8 its max HP.

rowap-berry.descES: Si la lleva un Pokémon cuando otro lanza un ataque especial, este último también recibe daño.
rowap-berry.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder takes special damage, it consumes this item to damage the attacking Pokémon for 1/8 its max HP.

bright-powder.descES: Lanza un destello que baja la Precisión del enemigo. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
bright-powder.descEN: Held in battle : Moves targeting the holder have 0.9x chance to hit.

white-herb.descES: Restaura cualquier característica reducida en combate. Solo se puede usar una vez. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
white-herb.descEN: Held in battle : At the end of each turn, if any of the holder’s stats have a negative stat modifier, the holder consumes this item to remove the modifiers from those stats.

macho-brace.descES: Sólido y pesado brazal que potencia aún más las características del Pokémon que lo lleva al subir de nivel, pero que reduce la Velocidad en combate.
macho-brace.descEN: Held : When the holder would gain effort due to battle, it gains double that effort instead. Held in battle : Holder has half its Speed.

exp-share.descES: Al activar el dispositivo, todos los Pokémon de tu equipo ganan Puntos de Experiencia tras los combates, aunque no salgan a luchar.
exp-share.descEN: Held : Experience is split across two groups: Pokémon who participated in battle, and Pokémon holding this item. Each Pokémon earns experience as though it had battled alone, divided by the number of Pokémon in its group, then divided by the number of groups. Pokémon holding this item who also participated in battle effectively earn experience twice. Fainted Pokémon never earn experience, and empty groups are ignored; thus, if a single Pokémon is holding this item and the only Pokémon who battled faints from Explosion, the holder will gain full experience.

quick-claw.descES: Garra ligera y afilada que permite que el Pokémon que la lleve ataque a veces el primero.
quick-claw.descEN: Held in battle : Whenever the holder attempts to use a move, it has a 3/16 chance to act first among moves with the same priority. If multiple Pokémon have this effect at the same time, Speed is the tie-breaker as normal, but the effect of Trick Room is ignored.

soothe-bell.descES: Un cascabel con un tañido calmante que reconforta al Pokémon que lo lleva y lo vuelve más amistoso.
soothe-bell.descEN: Held : When the holder would earn happiness for any reason, it earns twice that amount instead.

mental-herb.descES: El Pokémon que la lleva se libera del efecto de movimientos que restringen sus acciones. Solo puede usarse una vez.
mental-herb.descEN: Held in battle : When the holder is attracted, it consumes this item to cure the attraction.

choice-band.descES: Aumenta la potencia de los ataques físicos del Pokémon que la lleva, pero solo le permite usar un movimiento.
choice-band.descEN: Held in battle : Holder has 1.5x its Attack. When the holder attempts to use a move, all its other moves are disabled until it leaves battle or loses this item. The restriction ends even if this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo.

kings-rock.descES: El Pokémon que la lleva puede amedrentar al Pokémon al que le inflige daño.
kings-rock.descEN: Held in battle : Holder’s damaging moves have a 10% chance to make their target flinch. This chance applies independently to each hit of a multi-hit move. This item’s chance is rolled independently of any other move effects; e.g., a move with a 30% chance to flinch normally will have a 37% total chance to flinch when used with this item, because 3% of the time, both effects activate. Held by Poliwhirl or Slowbro : Holder evolves into Politoed or Slowking, respectively, when traded.

silver-powder.descES: Polvo de brillo argénteo que fortalece los ataques de tipo Bicho. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
silver-powder.descEN: Held in battle : Holder’s Bug-type moves have 1.2x their power.

amulet-coin.descES: Si el Pokémon que la lleva lucha en un combate, duplica las ganancias.
amulet-coin.descEN: Held : If the holder participated in a trainer battle, the trainer earns twice the usual prize money. This effect applies even if the holder fainted. This effect does not stack with any other similar effect.

cleanse-tag.descES: Si lo lleva el primer Pokémon del equipo, se reduce la probabilidad de que se acerquen Pokémon salvajes.
cleanse-tag.descEN: Held by lead Pokémon: Prevents wild battles with Pokémon that are lower level than the holder.

soul-dew.descES: Un orbe fantástico que debe llevar Latios o Latias. Potencia los movimientos de tipo Psíquico y Dragón.
soul-dew.descEN: Held by Latias or Latios: Increases the holder’s Special Attack and Special Defense by 50%.

deep-sea-tooth.descES: Tiene el brillo afilado de la plata y debe llevarlo Clamperl. Sube el Ataque Especial.
deep-sea-tooth.descEN: Held by Clamperl: Doubles the holder’s Special Attack. Evolves the holder into Huntail when traded.

deep-sea-scale.descES: Tiene un débil brillo rosado y debe llevarla Clamperl. Sube la Defensa Especial.
deep-sea-scale.descEN: Held by Clamperl: Doubles the holder’s Special Defense. Evolves the holder into Gorebyss when traded.

smoke-ball.descES: Debe llevarla un Pokémon. Permite huir siempre de combates contra Pokémon salvajes.
smoke-ball.descEN: Held: In wild battles, attempts to run away on the holder’s turn will always succeed.

everstone.descES: El Pokémon que lleva esta piedra mágica no evoluciona.
everstone.descEN: Held: Prevents the holder from evolving naturally. Evolution initiated by the trainer (Stones, etc) will still work.

focus-band.descES: El Pokémon que la lleva puede resistir un golpe que potencialmente lo dejaría K. O. y se queda con 1 PS.
focus-band.descEN: Held: If the holder is attacked for regular damage that would faint it, this item has a 10% chance to prevent the holder’s HP from lowering below 1.

lucky-egg.descES: Es un huevo lleno de felicidad que te hace ganar Puntos de Experiencia extra en combate. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
lucky-egg.descEN: Held: Increases any Exp the holder gains by 50%.

scope-lens.descES: Su lente aumenta la probabilidad que tiene el Pokémon que lo lleva de conseguir un golpe crítico.
scope-lens.descEN: Held: Raises the holder’s critical hit counter by 1.

metal-coat.descES: Película metálica que fortalece los ataques de tipo Acero. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
metal-coat.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Steel moves by 20%. Held by Onix or Scyther: Evolves the holder into Steelix or Scizor when traded, respectively.

leftovers.descES: Este objeto restaura gradualmente durante el combate los PS del Pokémon que lo lleva.
leftovers.descEN: Held: Heals the holder by 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.

dragon-scale.descES: Una gruesa y resistente escama que pueden llevar los Pokémon de tipo Dragón cuando son capturados.
dragon-scale.descEN: Held by Seadra: Evolves the holder into Kingdra when traded.

light-ball.descES: Asombrosa esfera que debe llevar Pikachu y que aumenta su Ataque y su Ataque Especial.
light-ball.descEN: Held by Pikachu: Doubles the holder’s initial Attack and Special Attack.

soft-sand.descES: Debe llevarla un Pokémon. La suavidad de la arena fortalece los movimientos de tipo Tierra.
soft-sand.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ground moves by 20%.

hard-stone.descES: Debe llevarla un Pokémon. La robustez de la piedra fortalece los movimientos de tipo Roca.
hard-stone.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Rock moves by 20%.

miracle-seed.descES: Debe llevarla un Pokémon. La vitalidad de la semilla fortalece los movimientos de tipo Planta.
miracle-seed.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Grass moves by 20%.

black-glasses.descES: Debe llevarlas un Pokémon. Fortalecen los movimientos de tipo Siniestro.
black-glasses.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Dark moves by 20%.

black-belt.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Aumenta la concentración y fortalece los movimientos de tipo Lucha.
black-belt.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Fighting moves by 20%.

magnet.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Su potente magnetismo fortalece los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico.
magnet.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Electric moves by 20%.

mystic-water.descES: Gema con forma de gota de agua que fortalece los movimientos de tipo Agua. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
mystic-water.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Water moves by 20%.

sharp-beak.descES: Pico largo y afilado que aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de tipo Volador. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
sharp-beak.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Flying moves by 20%.

poison-barb.descES: Flecha venenosa que refuerza los movimientos de tipo Veneno. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
poison-barb.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Poison moves by 20%.

never-melt-ice.descES: Fragmento de hielo que repele el calor y fortalece los movimientos de tipo Hielo. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
never-melt-ice.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ice moves by 20%.

spell-tag.descES: Misterioso y siniestro objeto que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fantasma. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
spell-tag.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ghost moves by 20%.

twisted-spoon.descES: Cuchara imbuida de energía telequinética que potencia los movimientos de tipo Psíquico. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
twisted-spoon.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Psychic moves by 20%.

charcoal.descES: Actúa como combustible y potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
charcoal.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Fire moves by 20%.

dragon-fang.descES: Colmillo de gran dureza que refuerza los movimientos de tipo Dragón. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
dragon-fang.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Dragon moves by 20%.

silk-scarf.descES: La delicadeza del pañuelo fortalece los movimientos de tipo Normal. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
silk-scarf.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Normal moves by 20%.

up-grade.descES: Peculiar dispositivo fabricado en Silph S. A. que contiene todo tipo de datos.
up-grade.descEN: Held by Porygon: Evolves the holder into Porygon2 when traded.

shell-bell.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Cada vez que este inflige daño, recupera algunos PS.
shell-bell.descEN: Held: Heals the holder by 1/8 of any damage it inflicts.

sea-incense.descES: Tiene un curioso aroma que potencia los movimientos de tipo Agua. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
sea-incense.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Water moves by 20%.

lax-incense.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Su peculiar aroma reduce la Precisión del objetivo.
lax-incense.descEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Evasion by 5%.

lucky-punch.descES: Un par de guantes que debe llevar Chansey. Potencian mucho su índice de golpe crítico.
lucky-punch.descEN: Held by Chansey: Raises the holder’s critical hit counter by 2.

metal-powder.descES: Debe llevarlo Ditto. Es un polvo muy fino, pero a la vez poderoso, que aumenta su Defensa.
metal-powder.descEN: Held by Ditto: Increases the holder’s initial Defense and Special Defense by 50%.

thick-club.descES: Un extraño tipo de hueso que potencia los ataques físicos de Cubone y Marowak cuando lo llevan.
thick-club.descEN: Held by Cubone or Marowak: Doubles the holder’s Attack.

stick.descES: Es un puerro muy largo que debe llevar Farfetch’d. Aumenta mucho la probabilidad de que logre un golpe crítico.
stick.descEN: Held by Farfetch’d: Raises the holder’s critical hit counter by 2.

red-scarf.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Aumenta el carisma en los concursos.
red-scarf.descEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Coolness during a Super Contest’s Visual Competition.

blue-scarf.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Aumenta la belleza en los concursos.
blue-scarf.descEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Beauty during a Super Contest’s Visual Competition.

pink-scarf.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Aumenta la dulzura en los concursos.
pink-scarf.descEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Cuteness during a Super Contest’s Visual Competition.

green-scarf.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Aumenta el ingenio en los concursos.
green-scarf.descEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Smartness during a Super Contest’s Visual Competition.

yellow-scarf.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Aumenta la dureza en los concursos.
yellow-scarf.descEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Toughness during a Super Contest’s Visual Competition.

wide-lens.descES: Debe llevarla un Pokémon. Aumenta ligeramente la precisión de los movimientos.
wide-lens.descEN: Held: Increases the accuracy of any move the holder uses by 10% (multiplied; i.e. 70% accuracy is increased to 77%).

muscle-band.descES: Cinta del pelo que aumenta ligeramente la potencia de los ataques físicos. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
muscle-band.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s physical moves by 10%.

wise-glasses.descES: Potencian ligeramente los ataques especiales. Debe llevarlas un Pokémon.
wise-glasses.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s special moves by 10%.

expert-belt.descES: Potencia ligeramente los movimientos supereficaces. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
expert-belt.descEN: Held: When the holder hits with a super-effective move, its power is raised by 20%.

light-clay.descES: Prolonga la duración de barreras como las creadas por Reflejo y Pantalla de Luz. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
light-clay.descEN: Held: The holder’s Reflect and Light Screen will create effects lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the barrier itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

life-orb.descES: Potencia los movimientos, pero consume PS con cada ataque. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
life-orb.descEN: Held: Damage from the holder’s moves is increased by 30%. On each turn the holder uses a damage-inflicting move, it takes 10% its max HP in damage.

power-herb.descES: Permite el uso inmediato de cualquier movimiento en el primer turno. Es de un solo uso y debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-herb.descEN: Held: Whenever the holder uses a move that requires a turn to charge first (Bounce, Dig, Dive, Fly, Razor Wind, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, or Solarbeam), this item is consumed and the charge is skipped. Skull Bash still provides a Defense boost.

toxic-orb.descES: Extraña esfera que envenena gravemente al Pokémon que la lleva en combate.
toxic-orb.descEN: Held: Badly poisons the holder at the end of each turn.

flame-orb.descES: Extraña esfera que causa quemaduras al Pokémon que la lleva en combate.
flame-orb.descEN: Held: Burns the holder at the end of each turn.

quick-powder.descES: Debe llevarlo Ditto. Es un polvo muy fino, pero a la vez poderoso, que aumenta su Velocidad.
quick-powder.descEN: Held by Ditto: Doubles the holder’s initial Speed.

focus-sash.descES: Si el Pokémon que la lleva tiene los PS al máximo, puede resistir un golpe que lo dejaría K. O. y se queda con 1 PS.
focus-sash.descEN: Held: If the holder has full HP and is attacked for regular damage that would faint it, this item is consumed and prevents the holder’s HP from lowering below 1. This effect works against multi-hit attacks, but does not work against the effects of Doom Desire or Future Sight.

zoom-lens.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Si se mueve después del enemigo, aumenta la Precisión del Pokémon.
zoom-lens.descEN: Held: Raises the holder’s Accuracy by 20% when it goes last. Ingame description is incorrect.

metronome.descES: Potencia un movimiento que se use de forma consecutiva. Pero el efecto se pierde si se emplea otro movimiento.
metronome.descEN: Held: Each time the holder uses the same move consecutively, its power is increased by another 10% of its original, to a maximum of 100%.

iron-ball.descES: Reduce la Velocidad. Los Pokémon que levitan y los de tipo Volador se tornan sensibles a movimientos de tipo Tierra.
iron-ball.descEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. If the holder is Flying or has Levitate, it takes regular damage from Ground attacks and is suspectible to Spikes and Toxic Spikes.

lagging-tail.descES: Es muy pesada y hace que el Pokémon que la lleva se mueva más lento de lo normal.
lagging-tail.descEN: Held: The holder will go last within its move’s priority bracket, regardless of Speed. If multiple Pokémon within the same priority bracket are subject to this effect, the slower Pokémon will go first. The holder will move after Pokémon with Stall. If the holder has Stall, Stall is ignored. This item ignores Trick Room.

destiny-knot.descES: Un hilo largo y delgado de color rojo que transmite el enamoramiento del Pokémon que lo lleva a su objetivo.
destiny-knot.descEN: Held: When the holder becomes Attracted, the Pokémon it is Attracted to becomes Attracted back.

black-sludge.descES: Si lo lleva un Pokémon de tipo Veneno, restaura gradualmente sus PS durante el combate. Si es de otro tipo, sus PS se reducirán.
black-sludge.descEN: Held: If the holder is Poison-type, restores 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn. Otherwise, damages the holder by 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.

icy-rock.descES: Prolonga la duración del movimiento Granizo que use el Pokémon que la lleva.
icy-rock.descEN: Held: The holder’s Hail will create a hailstorm lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

smooth-rock.descES: Prolonga la duración del movimiento Tormenta de Arena que use el Pokémon que la lleva.
smooth-rock.descEN: Held: The holder’s Sandstorm will create a sandstorm lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

heat-rock.descES: Prolonga la duración del movimiento Día Soleado que use el Pokémon que la lleva.
heat-rock.descEN: Held: The holder’s Sunny Day will create sunshine lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

damp-rock.descES: Prolonga la duración del movimiento Danza Lluvia que use el Pokémon que la lleva.
damp-rock.descEN: Held: The holder’s Rain Dance will create rain lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.

grip-claw.descES: Prolonga la duración de ataques multiturno como Atadura y Constricción si la lleva un Pokémon.
grip-claw.descEN: Held: Increases the duration of the holder’s multiturn (2-5 turn) moves by three turns.

choice-scarf.descES: Debe llevarlo un Pokémon. Potencia la Velocidad, pero solo permite usar un movimiento.
choice-scarf.descEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Speed by 50%, but restricts it to the first move it uses until it leaves battle or loses this item. If this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo, the holder’s restriction is still lifted, but it will again be restricted to the next move it uses. (Quirk: If the holder is switched in by U-Turn and it also knows U-Turn, U-Turn becomes its restricted move.)

sticky-barb.descES: Daña en cada turno al Pokémon que la lleva. Puede adherirse al Pokémon que alcance con su ataque al portador.
sticky-barb.descEN: Held: Damaged the holder for 1/8 its max HP. When the holder is struck by a contact move, damages the attacker for 1/8 its max HP; if the attacker is not holding an item, it will take this item.

power-bracer.descES: Potencia el Ataque de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
power-bracer.descEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Attack effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-belt.descES: Potencia la Defensa de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarlo un Pokémon.
power-belt.descEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Defense effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-lens.descES: Potencia el Ataque Especial de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-lens.descEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Special Attack effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-band.descES: Potencia la Defensa Especial de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-band.descEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Special Defense effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-anklet.descES: Potencia la Velocidad de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-anklet.descEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains Speed effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

power-weight.descES: Mejora los PS de base, pero reduce la Velocidad en combate. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
power-weight.descEN: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. Whenever the holder gains HP effort from battle, increases that effort by 4; this applies before the PokéRUS doubling effect.

shed-shell.descES: En combate, esta concha desechada permite que el portador siempre pueda cambiarse por otro Pokémon que no esté combatiendo.
shed-shell.descEN: Held: The holder is unaffected by any moves or abilities that would prevent it from actively leaving battle.

big-root.descES: El Pokémon que la lleva recupera más PS al usar movimientos que drenan al objetivo.
big-root.descEN: Held: HP restored from Absorb, Aqua Ring, Drain Punch, Dream Eater, Giga Drain, Ingrain, Leech Life, Leech Seed, and Mega Drain is increased by 30%. Damage inflicted is not affected.

choice-specs.descES: Aumentan la potencia de los ataques especiales del Pokémon que las lleva, pero solo le permiten usar un movimiento.
choice-specs.descEN: Held: Increases the holder’s Special Attack by 50%, but restricts it to the first move it uses until it leaves battle or loses this item. If this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo, the holder’s restriction is still lifted, but it will again be restricted to the next move it uses. (Quirk: If the holder is switched in by U-Turn and it also knows U-Turn, U-Turn becomes its restricted move.)

flame-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
flame-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Fire moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Fire.

splash-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Water moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Water.

zap-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Electric moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Electric.

earth-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ground moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Ground.

sky-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Flying moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Flying.

mind-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Psychic moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Psychic.

insect-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Bug moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Bug.

spooky-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ghost moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Ghost.

draco-plate.descES: Tabla de piedra que potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón. Debe llevarla un Pokémon.
draco-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Dragon moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Dragon.

dread-plate.descEN: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Dark moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Dark.
